type_note: user-visible: music is quieter when it starts.
summary: Music now starts at 25% instead of full volume, so a track does not bury the people talking over it.
details: Discord voice is loud, and a track at full scale made conversation hard to hear. `/music volume` still raises or lowers it for the rest of that connection; the next fresh connection starts quiet again.
limitations: It is a fixed starting point, not a setting: there is no config key for it yet. Ask and it becomes one.

This is a NEW choice, not a restoration, although 25% is the number that was in play before. Nothing ever defaulted music to that level — the earlier 0.25 was how far music was turned DOWN while Nora spoke over it, which the audio-controller rework replaced with a clean cut. Same number, different mechanism.
